The log-pressure delta is computed as ΔG/(2RT ln 10), per potassium atom. The construction uses K-012, T_fus 1013 K, ΔS_fus 33.74 J/(mol K), and Cp_l 97.75 J/(mol K). The runtime interval starts at 1200 K, above fusion. The combined selected-tier band samples are 7.419962, 14.625911, and 35.822955 kJ/mol at 1013, 1313, and 1813 K; the Cp band includes 104.6 J/(mol K).
